Stage 1 implementation, documentation, and quality gates complete; cross-platform real measurements remain explicitly documented as follow-up evidence.

Implemented: (1) stream_playback.feed() now emits levelReady per ~120ms window (cap 48/chunk) so the live meter advances at audio pace; (2) AppController gains waveformEnvelope (160 peak-normalized buckets, recomputed on done, cleared on new generation), replayPosition (QTimer+QElapsedTimer for RAM replay; mirrored player positionChanged for temp-file replay), replayDurationMs; (3) new PlaybackWaveform.qml — envelope overview with played/unplayed accent coloring, gliding glow playhead, mm:ss labels; (4) WaveformIndicator.qml gains fast-attack/slow-release bar animation + peak-hold caps (30fps timer only while moving, preserves tested level/active/historyCount API); (5) TextTab/ParagraphTab host both with slot gating (meter: streamActive && !replayActive; overview: hasAudio). 6 new stream_playback tests, 8 new controller tests, extended stream_bindings smoke contract. 701 tests pass, ruff clean. Visual verification via scripts/preview_waveform_widgets.py (offscreen screenshots of all three states).

Audiobook tab now has chapter waveform visualization: (1) envelope computation moved to core/audio.compute_waveform_envelope (shared by AppController + AudiobookController); (2) AudiobookLibrary persists a ch_XXXX.waveform.json sidecar next to each cached WAV (save/load, corrupt/missing/WAV-gone → None); (3) AudiobookController gains chapterEnvelope property — saved at render time from the synthesized audio, loaded instantly from the sidecar on play, with a deferred decode-from-WAV + persist fallback for chapters cached before sidecars existed; (4) PlaybackWaveform gains seekable + seekRequested(fraction) (click/drag-to-seek, app tabs keep it false); (5) AudiobookTab transport dock hosts chapterWaveform above the controls: visible when a chapter with an envelope is selected, playhead from positionMs/durationMs, click-to-seek maps to audiobook.seek. TDD: 5 audio-helper tests, 6 library sidecar tests, 6 controller tests, new ab_waveform smoke scenario (8 audiobook smoke tests green). 719 tests pass, ruff clean, offscreen preview frame rendered.

Fixed: PlaybackWaveform MouseArea handlers called a named seekHere() that referenced the handler-scoped 'mouse' parameter — a ReferenceError on every click, so seek never fired (reproduced in an isolated probe: 'ReferenceError: mouse is not defined'). Fix: arrow-function handlers (mouse) => root.seekRequested(fractionAt(mouse.x)); also added continuous drag scrubbing (onPositionChanged while pressed). Hardening along the way: AudiobookTab onSeekRequested now declares (fraction) formally (implicit injection is deprecated); paint() guards envelope===undefined during teardown repaints; ab-driver FakeAppController.modelsMissing is now a real Property (plain attr read as undefined, leaving the models-missing scrim at default visible=true and silently eating ALL real mouse events below it — masked until now because no ab scenario used real mouse input). Smoke test now drives the REAL mouse path: QTest.mouseClick at a scene-mapped point and a press-move-release drag, asserting seek routing (with sub-1% canvas-inset tolerance). 719 tests pass, ruff clean.

Capped by dc6: _process_infer no longer makes one whole-document engine.infer call — it dispatches split_text_for_streaming segments so each SDK call is bounded (same mechanism that holds the stream path at the ~1.1GB plateau, phase04/u5c evidence). Non-stream path is CLI/Python-only (shipped QML uses generateStream, which additionally enforces GENERATE_CHAR_LIMIT=60k at dc6). Direct long-text RSS measurement can still be run via scripts/benchmarks if ever needed.
